tickDerivation: Morrowind applies a lasting magic effect once per game second (OpenMW MagicEffects tick); a standing or burning volume re-casts on an actor inside once per second, never faster.

entries.name: Burning peat
entries.derivation: Skyrim.esm HAZD FireSpellHazard (the ground fire a fire spell leaves): radius 4 ft (Skyrim's hazard and spell areas are in feet; 4 x 0.3048 = 1.2192 m) and lifetime 7.0 s. A wider fire strike lights its own area: radius = max(strike area, 1.2192 m). The burning ground casts the lighting strike's effect and magnitude, once per tick.
entries.why: Peat is dried bog turf that burns where struck by fire; the slice places listed stand on the peat land cover (ground-control raster ids 9 and 28).

entries.name: Shocked water
entries.derivation: The shock spreads through the struck body of water over the attack's own area (a spell's areaMetres; an arrow's from Morrowind's enchant area rule), never less than Morrowind's 1 ft area unit (0.3048 m; OpenMW's cost formula takes max(1, area)). Every actor standing in the same water body inside it takes the attack's effect and magnitude once.

visual.source: packages/magic/src/fx/families.json areaRing (Skyrim fxenergyimpacring.dds) in the shock colour

entries.why: Lore topics/fauna-hazards.md: the wamasu is lightning-powered and electrifies the water around it, 'cursing all the water to deadly convulsions'.

entries.name: Fleshfly swarm
entries.derivation: Spell: hand-of-decay (drain-health touch 1, the Morrowind spell of flesh wasting away) because lore topics/fauna-hazards.md says fleshflies 'eat flesh'; the 1 point per tick matches sand-grain insects. Radius: Skyrim.esm meshes/actors/spriggan/fxsprigganswarm.nif is a particle swarm whose NiParticleSystem emitters (SwarmMagicPArray05-Emitter at 38.143, 62.550, -16.845 and SwarmTrailPArray05-Emitter at -2.426, 63.587, -44.280 Skyrim units, children of the root at the origin) bound the cloud; the farthest, the trail emitter, lies sqrt(2.426^2 + 63.587^2 + 44.280^2) = 77.6 units from the root. At 1 unit = 0.0142875 m (69.99 units per metre) that is 1.1087 m. The NIF is a particle system (its only mesh is the hidden Sphere05 emitter, radius 10.46 x 1.0823 = 11.3 units), so no glb exists to convert and it is drawn as a particle effect from the NIF.

visual.source: Skyrim.esm vault Skyrim - Meshes.bsa meshes/actors/spriggan/fxsprigganswarm.nif (particle swarm; textures FXLeafBug, FXGlowSpotLinearAlpha); not convertible to a glb

entries.why: The den sockets name carrion over stagnant water where fleshflies gather.

entries.name: Voriplasm pool
entries.derivation: Spell: dread-curse-health (damage-health touch 5) because lore topics/fauna-hazards.md says the voriplasm 'will strip you to the bone by the second syllable', a body dissolved at once, not poisoned. Radius: the shipped voriplasm.glb (voriplasm.set.json) is sizeMeters 2.0 at its longest axis (restSize 20.5074 x 0.09753 = 2.0 m; width 14.2102 x 0.09753 = 1.386 m); the pool reaches half its longest extent, 2.0 / 2 = 1.0 m from its centre.
entries.why: The voriplasm's acidic body pools where it lies.

entries.name: Dragon's tongue
entries.derivation: Spell: poisonous-touch (poison touch 15) because loading-facts text.loading.fact.dragons-tongue says the herb is 'lethal to the touch'. Radius: Skyrim.esm meshes/plants/dragonstongue01.nif (the INGR the sockets place, shipped as clutter/dragons-tongue.glb) measures 0.156 x 0.142 m (registry-vanilla sizeM) at scale 1.0 (the fill sockets carry no scale); the circle enclosing that footprint has radius sqrt(0.156^2 + 0.142^2) / 2 = 0.1055 m, the touch reach.
entries.why: loading-facts.md: dragon's tongue is a fern-like herb lethal to the touch.
